agent add: a new chat with its folder, a first message, and the reply read back
chat send / read / list / set / rename act on the chat a person sees
note new / read / list / page: a note with its text, open beside the chat and in Pages
tab open / activate / rename / list / close and favorite add work on the chat's tabs
terminal run / read: the terminal tab runs a command, and `barkdown` works inside it
without Full YOLO: settings, profiles and deletions are refused; the switch, quit and restart are never commands
a person turns Full YOLO on with the switch in Settings › Assistant
with Full YOLO: settings change live, a profile is created, a chat is deleted
with Full YOLO on, Barkdown still cannot switch Full YOLO, quit, or write a secret
the assistant's app tool: starts a helper chat and reads its reply; its own chat is the default; the switch and quit are refused
Full YOLO off again: administrative commands are refused for both callers; the log names who did what
